{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929","id":"msg_011CeeeAAd3e7rkGosfN1zoX","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"A Mersenne prime is a prime number that is one less than a power of 2, i.e., of the form 2^n - 1 where n is a positive integer.\n\nLet me check if 7 is a Mersenne prime:\n- First, is 7 prime? Yes, 7 is only divisible by 1 and 7.\n- Second, can 7 be written as 2^n - 1 for some positive integer n?\n  - 2^1 - 1 = 1\n  - 2^2 - 1 = 3\n  - 2^3 - 1 = 7\n  \nYes! 7 = 2^3 - 1, so 7 is a Mersenne prime.","signature":""},{"type":"text","text":"Yes, 7 is a Mersenne prime because it equals 2³ - 1 and is prime."}],"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":56,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":0,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":220,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":188},"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"}}
